summary: TIM S.A. filed a Form 6-K to notify debenture holders that it achieved the Eco-Efficiency Target defined in its 2nd debenture issuance, which required an 80% or greater increase in eco-efficiency (bit/joule) by December 2025 versus 2019. The achievement triggers a 0.125% reduction in coupon interest as of June 15, 2026. The target was validated by Bureau Veritas Certification Brasil. This is a routine ESG-linked bond reporting event, not a special situation.
